Skoda Octavia Estate

The Octavia Estate combines a large boot with efficient engines. Prices start at £27,500 on the road.

Engines

Two petrol engines and one diesel are available.

  • 1.5 TSI 150PS manual
  • 1.5 TSI 150PS DSG
  • 2.0 TDI 115PS manual
